currentParagraphText: “Everything in the multiverse is transactional to some extent,” the Viper said casually. “If you decided that you were happy with being a C-grade for the rest of your life and retired to spend your remaining days with your parents, I would definitely have you killed as having that kind of person as my Chosen would just be too damn embarrassing.”
